title: Get Listed
text: Want your show or your profile on this site? Fill out the form below. Submissions don’t go live automatically — every response gets reviewed first, and once it’s approved it appears on the site on its own.

title: Get Listed
text:
Add a Comedian Profile
Google won’t let us embed this one inline — forms with a photo upload question require the person filling it out to be signed into a Google account, and Google blocks embedding those in an iframe. It opens in its own tab instead.

Open the Comedian Form →


No form yet, or the submission didn’t go through? Email the details straight to candyscomedybaltimore@gmail.com and it’ll get added by hand.
